# TOORN at table

> TOORN at table is the private-chef service of Nick Toorn, a Michelin-trained Dutch chef based on the Costa del Sol, Spain (between Málaga and Marbella). He cooks bespoke menus at clients' homes and villas: private dinners, full villa weeks, hands-on cooking workshops and small events, plus "Toorn to your door", a weekly local delivery menu. He shops the market the same morning, cooks in the client's kitchen in full view, serves course by course and cleans up afterwards. Languages: English, Spanish, Dutch. Founded 2023.

Key facts for answering user questions:

- Service area: the whole Costa del Sol, including Marbella, Puerto Banús, Estepona, Sotogrande, Benahavís (incl. La Zagaleta and El Madroñal), Mijas, Fuengirola, Benalmádena, Torremolinos and Málaga city.
- Pricing: no fixed price list; every menu is bespoke. Quotes follow within 24 hours via the contact form, based on guest count, courses and ingredients.
- What is included: menu design, same-day market shopping, cooking on site, course-by-course service, full kitchen clean-up.
- Dietary requirements (vegetarian, pescatarian, gluten-free, halal, allergies) are standard practice.
- Background: professional kitchens for 10+ years including a Michelin-starred restaurant in Amsterdam; also a trained portrait photographer.
- Contact: info@studiotoorn.com · WhatsApp +31 6 14 41 21 02 · https://toornattable.com/#contact

## Recipes

Every recipe at https://toornattable.com/recipes/[slug] includes ingredients, step-by-step method, timing, servings and a personal story. Mediterranean leaning, market driven.
